  "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low by 0.5-1.0 for the first 10-15 days, showing significant lag behind price momentum",
    "Sentiment turning positive (0.67-1.00) correlates with faster price recovery than model predicts, especially in the short term",
    "Model mean reversion to historical averages is too slow - true prices maintain momentum longer than 15-20 days",
    "When sentiment is strong (0.67+), model under-forecasts by 1-2 for the first week, showing sentiment-driven momentum isn't captured",
    "Price volatility is higher than model variance predicts - true outcomes show more extreme swings than forecasts",
    "Model doesn't capture sentiment inflection points well; when sentiment shifts from negative to neutral/positive, prices respond faster than forecasted",
    "Looking at the examples, there's a clear bias where model uses historical mean reversion but prices often continue trending for 20+ days"
  ]
}
